india.one_line: India advances AI regulation, infrastructure investments, and indigenous model development across the sector.

themes.title: MeitY finalizes AI regulation papers
themes.text: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan announced that upcoming AI regulation papers are in their final stages. Additionally, the government found no misuse of IndiaAI support after reviewing startup Sarvam hosting Chinese-developed models.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
Government finds no misuse of IndiaAI support in Sarvam Chinese model row

themes.title: New Indic models and voice agents
themes.text: BharatGen launched Patram 1.5, a 7.8-billion-parameter vision-language model for documents. Meanwhile, IBM Research built a regional language voice agent using the CUGA harness to answer agricultural queries.

stories.headline: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
IBM Research builds Indic voice agent using CUGA harness

themes.title: Infrastructure and enterprise AI updates
themes.text: BP is transferring 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in an AI transformation deal. Nexent Capital launched a $1 billion fund for AI data-center infrastructure in North America and India, and Infosys reached CMMI AI Maturity Level 5.

stories.headline: BP to transfer 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in AI transformation deal
Nexent Capital launches $1 billion fund for AI data‑center and energy infrastructure
Infosys reaches CMMI AI Maturity Level 5, first organization worldwide
